caption: The video captures a person standing on a grassy cliff edge, back mostly to the camera, arms stretched sideways holding the top corners of a white banner printed with the five Olympic rings. A wide calm river runs beyond them, backed by a dense forested strip under a low sun in the upper-left that throws a bright glare onto the water. The banner, initially spread flat, ripples as its right half bunches and curls forward over the center. The cloth collapses into a narrower diagonal sheet wrapped around the body, the torso turning slightly before facing away again. The fabric re-opens, corners extending outward until the rings again display on a broad rectangular spread.
